name: Balrog
note: The Balrog expedition gathers at the Bottom of the Temple, deep in the Sleepywood dungeon. It is a boss fight for a group.

name: Zakum
note: Zakum is behind The Door to Zakum, at the bottom of the Dead Mine in El Nath. It is a boss fight for a group.

name: Horntail
note: Horntail's cave is inside the Cave of Life in Leafre, past the Dragon Canyon. It is a boss fight for a group.

name: Papulatus
note: Papulatus is summoned in the Origin of Clocktower, one room past Deep Inside the Clocktower at the bottom of the Ludibrium clocktower.

name: Pink Bean
note: Pink Bean is at Twilight of Gods, at the far end of the Temple of Time. It is a boss fight for a group.
